house.description: Funding provided for a driver education campaign related to the "Move Over" law when passing certain stopped vehicles, and money appropriated.

House.text: Introduction and first reading, referred to Transportation Finance and Policy

latest_action.text: Introduction and first reading, referred to Transportation Finance and Policy

bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to transportation; appropriating money for a driver education campaign related to the "Move Over" law when passing certain stopped vehicles.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. [+PUBLIC EDUCATION CAMPAIGN. +]

[+(a) The commissioner of public safety must implement a statewide information campaign to educate the public about laws requiring drivers to slow down and change lanes when passing certain stopped vehicles, consistent with Minnesota Statutes, section 169.18, subdivisions 11 and 11a. +]

[+(b) $....... in fiscal year 2027 is appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of public safety for the purposes of this section. This is a onetime appropriation. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to transportation; appropriating money for a driver education campaign related to the "Move Over" law when passing certain stopped vehicles.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. PUBLIC EDUCATION CAMPAIGN.

(a) The commissioner of public safety must implement a statewide information campaign to educate the public about laws requiring drivers to slow down and change lanes when passing certain stopped vehicles, consistent with Minnesota Statutes, section 169.18, subdivisions 11 and 11a.

(b) $....... in fiscal year 2027 is appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of public safety for the purposes of this section. This is a onetime appropriation.
additions: (a) The commissioner of public safety must implement a statewide information campaign to educate the public about laws requiring drivers to slow down and change lanes when passing certain stopped vehicles, consistent with Minnesota Statutes, section 169.18, subdivisions 11 and 11a.
(b) $....... in fiscal year 2027 is appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of public safety for the purposes of this section. This is a onetime appropriation.
